about: The 'friends having fun' montage (story beat 1:55-2:40). Phone footage from Cal Hacks, no faces on screen: backs of heads, hands, arms and laptops only; profile shots are cropped to the hand and the laptop. Times are seconds in the source file; crop is {x, y, w} in the source's displayed pixels (after rotation), height w*9/16; no crop means centre-crop to 16:9. 'said' is when the line is spoken in the source, for captions. Built by scripts/montage.mjs.

shots.why: Wide from behind: a player sat on the stairs, arm straight out aiming at the laptop. Sets the scene.
Pinching at the screen while calling the troop. Cropped to the hand and the laptop; the player's profile is right of frame.
Big pinch close to the lens, then aimed down at the laptop. Cropped below the railing so the passers-by upstairs are out of frame.
Over the shoulder (back of the head only), finger pointing the troop onto the board.
Pinch-aiming while saying the funniest troop of the day. Cropped to the hand and the laptop; the face is right of frame.
The game on the laptop while a ridiculous troop is described out loud.
shots.line: It's gonna be toilet that can shoot water balls.

shots.why: Two laptops facing each other on the floor, arm out pointing; a laugh and a dev aside mid-match. (This file's rotation tag is wrong; it is landscape as recorded.)
shots.line: Oh my god. We gotta calibrate the pinch.

shots.why: A fist pushes in over the screen to place the troop.
The excited one: pinching while describing a troop in one breath, then 'oh my god' as the phone swings to the screen. Cropped to the hand and the laptop.
shots.line: Flying car with missiles, like the Tesla Roadster. Oh my god!

shots.why: Close on the screen: troops piling up on the bridge.
Pointing hard at the laptop, escalating to an atomic bomb spawner, then the groan.
The ending: lost for words as the skeletons pour in, the board freezes over and it's DEFEAT, with a laugh.
shots.line: Oh my god, I'm at a loss for words. Skeleton army! Oh…
